description: Crypto spot price: Spot price and 24-hour change for up to 25 coins by CoinGecko id or common symbol (btc, eth, sol, usdc, ...), in USD or another major currency. Source: CoinGecko public API (keyless). Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: prices[{query, id, price, change_24h_pct, last_updated}], not_found[].

ids.description: comma-separated CoinGecko ids or symbols, e.g. btc,eth,usd-coin

vs.description: quote currency: usd, eur, gbp, jpy, cad, aud or chf (default usd)

name: x420_crypto_price
